summary_en: FY3/26 ROE 7.1%; PBR fell below 1.0x from ~1.0x in early March 2026 despite revenue and profit growth YoY and shareholder distribution expansion. Company to prioritize earnings growth under Mid-term Plan 2027 to improve enterprise value and further raise PBR.
title_en: Response to Realizing Capital-Cost and Stock-Price-Conscious Management (Update)
translation_en_brief: On 24 June 2026, Rhythm Co., Ltd. (TSE Prime 7769) issued an update to its capital-cost and stock-price-conscious management framework, originally announced 4 March 2024 and updated 24 March 2025. In FY3/26, the company achieved revenue and profit growth year-over-year under the Mid-term Plan 2027 (disclosed 23 June 2025 as revised) and expanded shareholder returns. ROE reached 7.1%. However, the price-to-book ratio (PBR), which had tracked near 1.0x through early March 2026, has since fallen below 1.0x. Management attributes this to valuation lags despite operational progress and reaffirms its commitment to prioritize earnings expansion through business investment funded by increased free cash flow, with the aim of raising enterprise value and PBR further.
